messages:
maya: Heads-up — EU canary for inference-api v3.4.2 is showing ~3x embeddings cost increase since 04:12 UTC. Not a traffic surge, looks like more tokens per request. Can we pause the roll? :eyes:
sam: saw it too. digging into traces, sample requests include full long docs instead of truncated embeds. dumping a sample payload in a sec.
deploy-bot: Deploy requested by julian for inference-api v3.4.2 -> v3.4.3 in eu-west-1. Canary 5% started at 04:10 UTC. Status: rolling, canary healthy 96%.
julian: I pushed a small change to embedding fallback earlier — might have removed truncation. If so, we should repin canary to v3.4.0 while I patch.
maya: Agreed. Pause the rollout and pin the canary to v3.4.0 so production traffic stays unaffected. This is within the change window but we should follow the rollback playbook.
ops-oncall: Reminder: pin-only for canary OK, but document impact. Are there downstream consumers that expect new behavior?
sam: quick snippet of offending call logs:
```
{"request_id":"abc123","tokens":8421,"operation":"embed","input_len":15200}
```
maya: That matches: the truncation step didn't run. If julian's patch reintroduces it we can unpin after QA signoff.
julian: I'll revert the truncation-line removal and run the canary smoke. Requesting emergency pin now.
sam: Use the deploy-bot pin command: `/deploybot pin inference-api eu-west-1 v3.4.0 --scope=canary`
deploy-bot: Command received. Canary pin applied: inference-api@eu-west-1 pinned to v3.4.0 (scope=canary). Expires in 10m. Audit id: pin-2026-04-eu-xyz. Rollout paused.
liz (qa): I'll update RELEASE_NOTES.md and the release checklist: add an explicit rollback step and QA hold for embeddings behavior. Marking this release as "hold for embedding regression".
maya: Please add a clear metric threshold: "If embeddings avg cost > 2x baseline for two consecutive 5-min windows, pin canary and page oncall." Put that in the release doc and the incident runbook.
ops-oncall: Acknowledged. I've alerted billing to watch cost anomalies and flagged the SLO dashboard.
deploy-bot: Note — pin will auto-expire in 10m. Use `/deploybot extend-pin pin-2026-04-eu-xyz 60m` to extend.
sam: Extending now: `/deploybot extend-pin pin-2026-04-eu-xyz 60m`
deploy-bot: Pin extended: +60m (new expiry in 70m). Audit updated.
julian: Patch applied and smoke tests pass locally. Requesting re-eval of canary after 8m once samples stabilize.
liz (qa): We'll run the embed regression suite when samples look normal. No unpin until QA confirms.
maya: Good. TL;DR: canary pinned, rollout paused, patch in flight, QA hold, ops watching costs. Keep this thread for final go/no-go. :thumbsup:
julian: Thanks all — will post results in ~8m.
ops-oncall: Standing by.
deploy-bot: pin-2026-04-eu-xyz extended by user sam. Audit complete.
